agent_explanation: Single body bounce violates energy conservation: high restitution (e=0.907) floor collision injects energy instead of dissipating it. Pre-impact speed ~18.67 m/s at step 60 should rebound at ~e*vin ≈16.9 m/s, but post-impact speed at step 61 is 19.73 m/s, larger than inbound, raising total mechanical energy from ~3017 J to 3363 J (limit 3324 J) with zero controller work. Likely impulse/positional-correction bug that adds energy on high-velocity substepped collision (7 substeps in step 61).
